run_benchpress_jobs: run benchmark jobs with benchpress CLI using the run command and job names
run_benchpress_dry_run: dry run benchpress benchmark jobs to preview execution commands without running them
run_benchpress_with_hooks: run benchpress benchmark jobs with additional hooks and hook arguments in JSON format
run_benchpress_with_role_input: run benchpress benchmark jobs with a specific role and role input JSON arguments
review_RunCommand_class: review the RunCommand class that extends BenchpressCommand to execute benchmark jobs with system specs collection
